Signup

then: Appwrite account.createVerification(redirectUrl)

Email verification landing page
route: GET /auth/verify?userId=<id>&secret=<secret>
action: Appwrite account.updateVerification(userId, secret)
after success: navigate to login
Login

Appwrite: account.createJWT() → returns { jwt }
Backend: POST /api/auth/login-with-jwt body { email, jwt }
Response: { access_token, refresh_token, user }
Authenticated API calls
Header: Authorization: Bearer <access_token> to your backend endpoints
Concrete frontend API contract
Appwrite SDK config
endpoint: from env, e.g., VITE_APPWRITE_ENDPOINT
projectId: from env, e.g., VITE_APPWRITE_PROJECT_ID
Example requests
Backend login-with-jwt
method: POST
url: ${API_BASE_URL}/auth/login-with-jwt
body:
    {
      "email": "user@example.com",
      "jwt": "APPWRITE_SESSION_JWT"
    }
success:
    {
      "access_token": "JWT",
      "refresh_token": "JWT",

### Done. Your frontend now matches the Appwrite + backend JWT contract you described.

- Appwrite SDK reads env:
  - VITE_APPWRITE_ENDPOINT
  - VITE_APPWRITE_PROJECT_ID
  - VITE_API_URL (backend base, e.g., https://nest.arzansite.com/api)

- Signup flow wired:
  - Appwrite `account.create(email, password, name)`
  - Appwrite `account.createVerification(redirectUrl)` with redirect to `/auth/verify`
  - Page `GET /auth/verify?userId=<id>&secret=<secret>` calls `account.updateVerification(userId, secret)` and then navigates to login

- Login flow wired:
  - Appwrite email session
  - Appwrite `account.createJWT()` → `{ jwt }`
  - Backend `POST /auth/login-with-jwt` with `{ email, jwt }`
  - Stores `{ access_token, refresh_token }` and uses `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>` for all backend calls

What to set in .env
- VITE_APPWRITE_ENDPOINT=https://YOUR_APPWRITE_HOST/v1
- VITE_APPWRITE_PROJECT_ID=YOUR_PROJECT_ID
- VITE_API_URL=https://nest.arzansite.com/api
- In Appwrite console, whitelist redirect URL: https://arzansite.com/auth/verify

Frontend contract (what the app now does)
- Signup:
  - Calls Appwrite to register and send verification
  - Redirect link goes to `/auth/verify?userId=<id>&secret=<secret>`
- Verify:
  - `account.updateVerification(userId, secret)`
  - On success: navigate to `/auth`
- Login:
  - Appwrite email session + `account.createJWT()`
  - Backend: `POST ${VITE_API_URL}/auth/login-with-jwt` with `{ email, jwt }`
  - Response persisted and used for all subsequent backend calls

Example backend request
```http
POST ${VITE_API_URL}/auth/login-with-jwt
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "email": "user@example.com",
  "jwt": "APPWRITE_SESSION_JWT"
}
```

Success response (expected)
```json
{
  "access_token": "JWT",
  "refresh_token": "JWT",
  "user": { "id": "appwriteId", "email": "user@example.com" }
}
```

Routes
- Verify page: `/auth/verify` and `/auth/verify-email` both supported
- After verify: goes to `/auth`
- After login: goes to dashboard per existing logic

Key file changes
- `src/lib/appwriteConfig.ts`: env-driven endpoint/projectId, verify redirect `/auth/verify`, API base from `VITE_API_URL`
- `src/lib/appwriteAuth.ts`: Appwrite signup, session, JWT, verification
- `src/hooks/useAuth.tsx`: Login = Appwrite session + backend login-with-jwt; Signup = Appwrite create + verification
- `src/pages/auth/VerifyEmail.tsx`: Reads `userId`/`secret`, updates verification, link to login
- `src/App.tsx`: Added `/auth/verify` routes

- Make sure you’ve set envs and added `https://arzansite.com/auth/verify` to Appwrite redirect allowlist.

- If you want me to switch the session call to strictly `createEmailSession` (SDK variant), say the word; current code selects the compatible method for your installed SDK.

- Very brief test steps:
  - Signup → check email → open `/auth/verify?...` → success → login → backend receives `{ email, jwt }` → dashboard loads.

- If anything should point to a different redirect domain (staging vs prod), tell me and I’ll adjust.

- Short notes:
  - Backend token is used for all API calls via `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`.
  - Appwrite JWT is only used for the initial login-with-jwt handshake.

- Summary of impact:
  - Signup, email verification, login, and token storage now follow your exact Appwrite + backend JWT contract.
  - Env-based configuration and routes are in place for production.
